summary.business_type: Travel / Informational — Chinese archaeology tourism guides
top_findings: OG images are 1.8–2.6 MB each (target: <300 KB)
No llms.txt for AI crawler visibility
Homepage hero image has no srcset
No Unsplash preconnect or font preloading
Blog index page is thin (216 words) and has no schema
Title tags contain HTML entities in rendered output
quick_wins: Compress OG images to quality 75 (80-150 KB each)
Add 3 missing blog URLs to sitemap
Create llms.txt with key page descriptions
Add lastmod dates to all sitemap URLs

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Clean static HTML — all content immediately crawlable
robots.txt correctly allows all crawlers with sitemap declaration
Every page has proper canonical URL and hreflang tags
Clean URL structure with descriptive slugs
Solid internal linking: 24-28 unique links per page

findings.title: Sitemap missing 3 pages
findings.description: The blog index (/blog) and both blog posts are absent from sitemap.xml. Sitemap has 20 URLs vs 23 actual pages.
findings.recommendation: Add /blog, /blog/chinese-neolithic-jade-guide, and /blog/liangzhu-vs-sanxingdui to sitemap.xml.

findings.title: No lastmod or changefreq in sitemap
findings.description: 0/20 sitemap URLs have lastmod or changefreq. Google must guess content freshness.
findings.recommendation: Add <lastmod> and <changefreq>monthly</changefreq> to every sitemap URL.

findings.title: No security headers
findings.description: Missing Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, HSTS, Referrer-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Configure at CDN/server level (Cloudflare, Netlify). See ACTION-PLAN.md for full config.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Strong E-E-A-T: firsthand visits, passport-tested, verified prices
Genuinely useful content — real ticket prices, step-by-step booking
Clear audience targeting for English-speaking foreign travelers
Good word counts on core pages: 645-1049 words

findings.title: Blog index page is thin (216 words)
findings.description: The blog index at /blog has only 216 words with 2 real posts and 2 placeholder links.
findings.recommendation: Expand to 300+ words with category descriptions, or merge into main site.

findings.title: Blog post 'Liangzhu vs Sanxingdui' is thin (247 words)
findings.description: Strong comparison topic but execution is brief with only 1 H2 heading.
findings.recommendation: Expand to 600+ words with comparison table, add sections on cost, crowds, accessibility.

findings.title: No author pages or bylines
findings.description: No author property in Article schema, no About page, no visible author credentials.
findings.recommendation: Create an About page and add author metadata to Article schema.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Well-crafted title tags with keyword placement and branding
Unique meta descriptions: 125-221 characters, keyword-rich
Exactly 1 H1 per page with clear heading hierarchy
Clean, descriptive URL slugs
Comprehensive OG tags and Twitter Card markup

findings.title: Title tag HTML entities in rendered output
findings.description: Titles show ' instead of ' and & instead of & in rendered HTML.
findings.recommendation: Fix Astro template to avoid double-encoding. Use set:html or @html directives.

findings.title: All pages use generic og-default.webp
findings.description: 23 pages all use the same OG image despite 12 site-specific ones existing on disk.
findings.recommendation: Map each page to its specific OG image in the layout component.

findings.title: No breadcrumb markup outside homepage
findings.description: Only the homepage has BreadcrumbList schema. Site guides and blog posts should too.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList schema to all site guide and blog pages.

categories.name: Schema & Structured Data
what_works: All 22 JSON-LD blocks parse as valid JSON
Rich type coverage: TouristAttraction, TravelGuide, HowTo, FAQPage, Article, ItemList
PostalAddress and Offer markup on site guide pages
FAQPage markup on key pages for direct answer SERP features

findings.title: Blog index has zero schema
findings.description: The /blog page is the only page with no structured data at all.
findings.recommendation: Add Blog + ItemList + BlogPosting schema to blog index.

findings.title: Unconventional schema wrapper on booking guides
findings.description: Booking guides wrap schema as ["...", "..."] (JSON strings in array) instead of [{...}, {...}] (objects in array).
findings.recommendation: Use proper object array syntax for wider validator compatibility.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Static HTML — near-instant TTFB on CDN
CSS: single file, 22.1 KB
Self-hosted fonts: 328 KB total
No render-blocking JavaScript
No third-party tracking scripts

findings.title: OG images are 1.8-2.6 MB each
findings.description: 12 OG images total 27 MB. Largest: og-terracotta.webp at 2.6 MB for a 1200x630 image.
findings.recommendation: Recompress all OG images to quality 75, target 80-150 KB each.

findings.title: No srcset on hero image
findings.description: Homepage hero loads a single 1800x1200 image eagerly. Mobile users download desktop-sized image.
findings.recommendation: Generate responsive sizes and add srcset + sizes attributes.

findings.title: No preconnect for Unsplash CDN
findings.description: 9 homepage images from images.unsplash.com with no DNS pre-resolution.
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel='preconnect' href='https://images.unsplash.com'>

findings.title: No font preloading
findings.description: 20 font files load via CSS discovery only. First text paint waits for font resolution.
findings.recommendation: Preload Outfit 700 and Geist Sans 400 as critical font files.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All content is static HTML — fully crawlable by AI bots
robots.txt allows all crawlers
FAQPage schema provides direct answer candidates
Clear topical focus per page

findings.title: No llms.txt or ai.txt file
findings.description: AI crawlers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude use llms.txt for structured content discovery.
findings.recommendation: Create /llms.txt with structured listing of all key pages.

findings.title: No AI-specific crawler rules in robots.txt
findings.description: robots.txt uses User-agent: * but doesn't explicitly address GPTBot, CCBot, PerplexityBot, etc.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit Allow directives for major AI crawler bots.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All images have descriptive alt text
Explicit loading attributes: eager for hero, lazy for below-fold
OG images in WebP format
CSS preserves aspect ratios with aspect-[3/2] and object-cover

findings.title: OG images are 12 files, 27 MB total
findings.description: See Performance section. Recompress from lossless to quality 75.
findings.recommendation: Use cwebp -q 75 or sharp to recompress all OG images.

findings.title: Unsplash images at fixed resolutions
findings.description: Hero at 1800x1200, cards at 600x400 — no responsive image sizes.
findings.recommendation: Add srcset with 600w, 900w, 1200w, 1800w breakpoints.

findings.title: No width/height attributes on Unsplash images
findings.description: Images lack explicit dimensions, creating CLS risk if CSS fails to load.
findings.recommendation: Add width and height attributes matching aspect-[3/2] container.

findings.title: Content pages have zero inline images
findings.description: 8 site guides with 600-800 words and no supporting images.
findings.recommendation: Add 1-2 relevant images per content page to improve engagement and SEO.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Compress OG images to <150 KB each
Add 3 missing blog URLs to sitemap
Add lastmod and changefreq to all sitemap URLs
Create llms.txt
Fix title tag HTML entities

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add preconnect for images.unsplash.com
Preload critical fonts
Add responsive srcset to hero image
Use page-specific OG images
Configure security headers at CDN level
Add Blog schema to blog index
Add AI crawler rules to robots.txt

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Expand thin blog posts to 600+ words
Create About page with author credentials
Add inline images to content pages
Add BreadcrumbList schema to all pages
Add aggregateRating to TouristAttraction schema

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Set up Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools
Submit sitemap to both engines
Monitor Core Web Vitals in GSC
Track AI citation rates
Monthly sitemap audit
